note: Straight-alpha RGBA layers, far to near. Each PNG includes the overscan margin; place its top-left at `offset` in painting coordinates. depth: suggested parallax factor (0 = sky ... 1 = nearest). flat.png = all layers composited with normal blending.

layers.name: sky
layers.note: sunrise sky, sun just rising upper right, clouds lit from below; opaque

layers.name: far
layers.note: four forested ridges fading with aerial perspective, mist in each valley

layers.name: mist
layers.note: the sea of mist in the valleys; glow and a shaft of light falling into the gap

layers.name: mid
layers.note: the forest canopy below with the gap of the clearing (x~1250, y~640) and rising mist

layers.name: near
layers.note: near canopy in two rows of painted silhouettes: varied crowns, a few snags and bare branches against the misty valley, mist in the dips, rims on some crowns only

camera: slow pan left -> right over 4.5 s (any 1920-wide window)
